caption: each VALUE is replaced, not the position it sits in — 4 is past the cycle's support, so it is fixed
on Cycles, PermutationReplace conjugates: every point the cycle names is relabelled by the second permutation
the result prints the way [[Cycles]] always does when it's computed rather than typed: smallest point first, singletons dropped — not whatever rotation the per-point relabelling happened to produce
conjugating by $p$ then by $q$ is conjugating by their composite: two steps land where one big permutation would
